fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

let empty = ""

let filled = "text"

write_line("empty is empty: {empty.length == 0}")
write_line("filled is empty: {filled.length == 0}")
write_line("filled is not empty: {filled.length > 0}")
write_line("null or empty: {string.is_null_or_empty(empty)}")
output:
empty is empty: True
filled is empty: False
filled is not empty: True
null or empty: True
